hook.name: ChamberHook
hook.description: A gamified trading hook implementing a Russian roulette mechanic for a single native ETH/token pool. Tracks swaps as trigger pulls through six rotating chambers, computing danger scores from volume and tick movement to determine bang (loss) or click (win) outcomes with configurable risk tiers. Swaps are restricted to a designated chamberRouter and require encoded hookData specifying a player address and risk tier.
